components.css: .ds-form { display: flex; gap: 8px; max-width: 30rem; } .ds-input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-primary, #D0D5DD); background: #fff; color: var(--color-text-primary, #101828); font: 400 15px 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(16 24 40 / 0.05); transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-placeholder, #667085); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-primary, #7237FB); outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary-200, #DACBFF); outline-offset: 0; } .ds-submit { height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--color-primary, #7237FB); color: #fff; font: 500 15px 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(16 24 40 / 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-submit:hover { background: var(--color-primary-600, #5F1FEF); } .ds-submit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #7237FB); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
A white page with one centred 1200px column, framed full-height by two 1px hairlines and cut into sections by full-width hairlines. Inside that frame the page is quiet: Geist in near-black, semibold headings with tight negative tracking, and plenty of air. The product carries the visual weight. Every section's image is the rebuilt Novara app in Inter, set on a pale plate, and it animates once to show the feature working.

The density is low and the rhythm even. Sections alternate between white and the pale gray plate (#F9FAFB), so the page reads as a stack of ruled bands, not floating cards. Violet is rare. It marks actions (buttons, focus, caret, selection) and data (funnel bars, the hired bar, chart bars, active states inside the product UI). The brand gradient appears exactly once, as a masked horizon glow behind the hero product shot.

This system documents the /v2 page. Tokens, the product UI components and the motion bootstrap are shared with /v1 (see the closing note in Components).
keyCharacteristics: One 1200px column framed by border-secondary hairlines, with a hairline at the top of every section.
White and #F9FAFB bands alternate, and there are no section backgrounds beyond those two.
Geist for the page and Inter for the product UI. The two never swap roles.
Violet only on actions and data, and the gradient only once.
Product UI as the imagery: real text, live counters, no illustrations or stock imagery.

rules.name: The Actions-and-Data Rule
rules.body: Violet appears on things you can press and on numbers that matter. It never fills a section, a heading or decorative shape.

rules.name: The One Horizon Rule
rules.body: The brand gradient is used once per page, masked, behind product UI. Never behind text and never on a button.

rules.name: The Tint-Not-Fill Rule
rules.body: Status color is a 10% tint with a dot and dark text, so contrast stays above 4.5:1.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Geist speaks for the page and Inter speaks for the product. Don't set marketing copy in Inter or product UI in Geist.

rules.name: The Single Weight Rule
rules.body: Headings are always 600 with negative tracking. Hierarchy comes from size and color, never from adding bold or light weights.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Marketing surfaces (sections, plates, bento tiles, the FAQ) never cast shadows. Only product UI is lifted.

dos: Do keep every section inside the 1200px hairline-framed column, with a full-width top hairline.
Do alternate white and Plate Gray (#F9FAFB) bands, and only those two.
Do show features as rebuilt product UI in Inter on a plate, with real text and a screen-reader caption.
Do keep violet to actions and data, and make the final or most important bar the only full-strength one.
Do set headings in Geist 600 with -0.03em tracking and balanced wrapping.
Do animate once, on entry, with expo-out, and leave every end state visible without JS or under reduced motion.
donts: Don't use the brand gradient anywhere but the single hero horizon, and never behind text.
Don't put shadows on marketing surfaces. Shadows are for product UI.
Don't fill status chips with full-strength color. Use the 10% tint, a dot and dark text.
Don't pin sections or hijack scroll on this page.
Don't introduce colors outside the token palette. The palette is binding.
